There's something about them that I don't trust.|audio = BathroomApproachWave 23 1.ogg|[[Dispatcher]] dialogue on Wave 18 ([[Bathroom Approach]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Operator Ducky''' is an enemy that appears in [[Bathroom Approach]] as part of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] and its rerun in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. It has decent health and an above average speed. Upon reaching 60% of its health, it activates its ''Operative Service'' ability, which spawns an [[Aggro]] and [[Bloated]] [[Agent Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Agent Ducky]]. It also turns it into a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy for 20 seconds, briefly limiting the amount of towers you can use against it. [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] disappearing after 20 seconds also happens if the '''Operator Ducky''' initially spawned as [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]]. ==Logbook Description== "''Operator Ducky is a dedicated "War Head" who eats grenades for breakfast and military tactics for lunch. Their idea of a relaxation is planning elaborate military operations while wearing full military gear. Many of the ducks believe he's LARPing as his hand-eye coordination is as bad as Missile Ducky's inability to not blow something up.''" ==Appearance== The '''Operator Ducky''' is regular, yellow duck with black eyes, an orange beak and flippers. It is a part of the Duck Army, meaning it wears appropriate military attire, which consists of a grey cap, headphones and headset. It has three animations that it can randomly have, where all three also have differently shaped eyes. The first animation has it have a happy expression, the second has it have a serious expression while the third one has its eyes partially closed, likely because it is scared. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Bathroom Approach]] is listed instead. *As the '''Operator Ducky''' can become [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]], towers such as the [[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]] and [[Golden Minigunner]] are good choices against the '''Operator Ducky'''. **Towers without hidden detection, like the top path [[Pursuit]], [[Ranger]] or [[Mortar]] can also be used to attack it before it turns [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] or when it loses [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]], though they should generally not be relied on. ***Do note that the [[Agent Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Agent Ducky]] that it spawns is not [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]], meaning towers without hidden detection can still indirectly attack the '''Operator Ducky''' while it is [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1OperatorDucky1.png|Green variant, current version, first animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1OperatorDucky2.png|Green variant, current version, second animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1OperatorDucky3.png|Green variant, current version, third animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseOperatorDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} DuckHunt2025PI2.png|'''Operator Ducky''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Ducky Revenge Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Operator Ducky''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} OperatorDuckyIconIG.png|'''Operator Ducky''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Operator Ducky''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 April 2025''' -
